cards.title: Say cloudy

Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.

articulation.label: cloudy
articulation.alt: cloudy: /k/ → /l/ → /aʊ/ → /d/ → /i/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/a/: Start with the tongue low and jaw open.
/ʊ/: Raise the back tongue; round the lips.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.
